greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Kwangathi umusa noxolo lukaNkulunkulu uYise naye iNkosi yethu uJesu Kristu kungaba nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usihawukele. Kristu, usihawukele. Nkosi, usihawukele.
homily:
Kukhona umzuzu omncane, othi cwaka, owenzeka ezindlini eziningi kakhulu lapho kukhona izingane. Cabanga ngomzuzu lapho umntwana encike ekhanda lakhe efasiteleni, ebuka izindiza zidlula esibhakabhakeni, ecabanga ngezinto ezinkulu ezifana ne-'con chim airlines' yakhe. Kulo mzuzu, akukho kubaleka, akukho ukuzenza, kukhona nje ukuba khona. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owawuphila lo mzuzu ngokugcwele. Wayengumfana owawubona umhlaba ngamehlo okumangala, ngengqondo eyayifuna ukwakha, ukucabanga, nokunxibelelana nazo zonke izinto ezintsha. Wayengumfana owawunentliziyo eyayiphila ngothando oluhlanzekileyo, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukunika ngaphandle kokubala.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaYobhi, uNkulunkulu uthetha noYobhi esivunguvungwini. Uthi kuye: 'Wawuphi na mhla ndisekela isiseko sehlabathi? Xela, ukuba unokuqonda.' La mazwi kaNkulunkulu awawona amazwi okusibeka icala, kodwa awamazwi okusikhumbuza ukuba akukho mntu owaziyo zonke izinto ngaphandle koMdali. UYobhi, emva kwayo yonke intlungu yakhe, uyamvuma uNkulunkulu waza wathi: 'Ndiyeza ndize ze esizalweni sikamama, ndiya kubuyela ndize ze apho.' UYobhi uqonda ukuba ubomi buphuma kuNkulunkulu, kwaye buya kuNkulunkulu. Le yimfihlo enzulu esiyiphilayo namhlanje, njengoko sikhumbula uBen.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba iinyanga ezintathu ezi zidlulileyo bezinzima kakhulu. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo iziva ngathi iyaphuka, xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe, owayekuthanda, owayekujonga ngamehlo anothando. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthatha umntwana wammisa phakathi kwabafundi bakhe. Uthi: 'Lowo uyamkela lo mntwana egameni lam, uyamkela mna.' UYesu usixelela ukuba izingane zinomsebenzi okhethekileyo phambi koThixo, kwaye izingelosi zazo zihlala zibukele ubuso bukaYise. UBen ngoku ungulowo mntwana, ukhanya phambi koThixo, ukhanya ngothando lwakhe olungasoze lwavaleleka. Khumbula indlela awayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Lo moya wokunika waba yindlela yakhe yokuphila. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukudala, owayethanda ukuhleka, owayethanda ukuba nani.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu.

Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. UBen wayengumfana owayenomdla ongamangalisiyo, owayesoloko ecinga ngezinto ezinkulu—ukusuka kwikhowudi zekhompyutha ezintsonkothileyo ukuya kwindlela ezindiza ngayo iindiza ezinkulu ezifana ne-Boeing 737. Wayengumfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwento nje eqhelekileyo. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukubaluleka kothando kunazo zonke izinto.

Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Namhlanje, njengoko sijonga iengelosi zinyuka zihla, masikhumbule ukuba uBen uphi na. Uphakathi kwabo, ekhanya, esithanda, esibukele. Masiphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Jesu wam, ndikholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente eNgcwele. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndikwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, kwaye ndizimanyanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndohlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Kwangathi iNkosi ingasibusisa, isigcine ebubini, isikhokelele ebomini obungunaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: INkosi yaphendula uYobhi isesivunguvungwini, yathi: 'Wake wayalela kusasa ebomini bakho, wambonisa indawo yokusa? Ukuze abambe imiphetho yomhlaba, ukuze abangendawo bavuthelwe kuyo? Umhlaba utshintsha njengodongwe phantsi kwetywina, ube nemibala njengengubo; kodwa ukukhanya kuthintelwe kubangendawo, ingalo yokuzidla yaphukile. Ngaba ungene kwimithombo yolwandle, okanye uhambahambe ezinzulwini zenzonzobila? Ngaba amasango okufa ubonisiwe, okanye uwabonile amasango obumnyama? Ngaba uyiqondile ububanzi bomhlaba? Ndixelele, ukuba uyazi konke: Yiyiphi indlela eya kwindawo yokuhlala yokukhanya, kwaye iphi indawo yobumnyama, ukuze uyise kwimida yayo kwaye uyibeke kwiindlela zayo zasekhaya? Uyazi, kuba wazalwa phambi kwazo, kwaye inani leminyaka yakho likhulu!' Wandula uYobhi waphendula iNkosi wathi: 'Nantsi, ndingumntu ongenanto; ndingaphendula ntoni kuwe? Ndibeka isandla sam emlonyeni wam. Nangona ndithethile kanye, andiyi kuphinda; nangona kabini, andiyi kwenza kwakhona.'

readings.label: INdumiso yokuPhendula
readings.text: R. Khokela, Nkosi, endleleni yaphakade. O Nkosi, undivavanyile kwaye uyandazi; uyazi xa ndihleli xa ndimi; uziqonda iingcinga zam ukususela kude. Iindlela zam nokuphumla kwam uyakuhlola, kwaye uziqhelile zonke iindlela zam. R. Khokela, Nkosi, endleleni yaphakade. Ndingaya phi kulo moya wakho? Ndingabaleka phi ebusweni bakho? Ukuba ndinyuka ndiye ezulwini, ulapho; ukuba ndihla ndiye kwelabafileyo, ukhona apho. R. Khokela, Nkosit, endleleni yaphakade. Ukuba ndithatha amaphiko okusa, ukuba ndihlala kwimida ekude yolwandle, nalapho isandla sakho siya kundikhokela, nesandla sakho sokunene siye kundibamba ngokuqinileyo. R. Khokela, Nkosi, endleleni yaphakade. Ngokwenene ubumile ubukho bam obungaphakathi; undilukile esizalweni sikamama. Ndiyakubulela ukuba ndenziwe ngendlela eyoyikekayo, emangalisayo; imisebenzi yakho iyamangalisa. R. Khokela, Nkosi, endleleni yaphakade.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Abafundi beza kuYesu bathi, 'Ngubani omkhulu kubukumkani bezulu?' Wabiza umntwana, wammisa phakathi kwabo, wathi, 'Amen, ndithi kuni, ukuba aniguquki naba njengabantwana, aniyi kungena kubukumkani bezulu. Lowo uzithobayo njengalo mntwana nguye omkhulu kubukumkani bezulu. Kwaye oyamkela umntwana onjalo egameni lam, uyamkela mna. Jonga ukuba ungawadeleli amancinane la, kuba ndithi kuni, iingelosi zawo ezulwini zihlala zibukele ubuso bukaBawo osezulwini.'

day: Memorial of the Holy Guardian Angels

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
